# Platform properties

*Feature* · also written platform property

Search Console properties for a site's social and video platform channels, showing how that content performs in Google Search.

**Glossary** (*Platform properties*): Search Console properties for Instagram, TikTok, X or YouTube accounts, verified through a pop-up from the platform, that show how the account's content performs on Google Search, Discover and Google News.

14 claims mention it: 3 from Google's documentation, 10 shown or said at the event (1 not in Google docs, 5 confirmed by Google docs, 3 consistent with Google docs, 1 nothing to verify), 1 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [About platform properties in Search Console](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/17148418?hl=en), [See how content from social and video platforms performs on Google Search](https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/07/search-console-social-video-platforms), [Analyze your social and video platform content performance in Search Console](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/monitor-debug/analyze-social-video-content).

- [`D3-C466`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Docs: Google's help page on platform properties says ownership is checked periodically and, if the external login expires, access pauses until the account is re-verified; each account or channel needs its own property, and data takes a few days to appear. `[D3-C466, docs, Google Search Console Help, https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/17148418?hl=en]`
- [`D3-C467`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Docs: Google's help page says platform properties show only how content performs on Google Search, Discover and Google News, not how often it is seen on the social or video platform itself. `[D3-C467, docs, Google Search Console Help, https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/17148418?hl=en]`
- [`D3-C468`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Docs: Google's social and video performance guide says that if you already claimed your Search profile, all of its verified accounts are added automatically as platform properties in Search Console. `[D3-C468, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/monitor-debug/analyze-social-video-content]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D3-C444`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, not in Google docs: Google said it is working on adding more platforms to Search Console's platform properties beyond Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube. `[D3-C444, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C442`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Search Console launched platform properties, which bring social platforms into Search Console, about three or four months before the October 2026 event. `[D3-C442, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C443`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Platform properties let a user verify ownership of an Instagram, TikTok, X or YouTube account in Search Console and see the traffic Google sends to that account. `[D3-C443, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C449`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Platform properties also show the query groups that lead to the account's content and the countries that send it traffic. `[D3-C449, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C450`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Because platform properties bring many new users to Search Console, Google published documentation and strategy guidance on them, covering how to identify the Search audience, use the 24-hour real-time view, export data and compare platforms such as Instagram and YouTube. `[D3-C450, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C451`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: In a YouTube platform property, long-form and short-form videos can be compared in the Performance report's comparison mode by URL pattern, /watch versus /shorts/; Instagram posts (/p/) and reels can be compared the same way. `[D3-C451, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C446`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: A platform property is verified entirely from within Search Console: a pop-up from the platform, for example Instagram, asks the user to grant Google permission to identify the account and its handle, and completing it proves ownership without a token. `[D3-C446, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C447`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: Platform properties have a newly designed landing page, similar to the Insights report, that shows overall clicks and the search types that lead to the account. `[D3-C447, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C448`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: The platform property landing page lists the account's top-performing content items, for example a channel's top YouTube videos, and the items trending up and trending down. `[D3-C448, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C412`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, nothing to verify: Google's Search Console talk at the Deep Dive covered five Search Console launches of the past year: query groups, AI-powered configuration of the Performance report, generative AI control and reporting, platform properties for social accounts, and multimodal search reporting. `[D3-C412, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D3-C453`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Analysis: Media teams that publish on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or X should add each account as a Search Console platform property and compare formats by URL pattern; Google's July 2026 post says an account already used for a Search profile should already give access to its data. `[D3-C453, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
